patthana17.24:1.1: Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana17.24:2.1: Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naasaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi… hetuyā cha. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ
patthana17.24:3.1: akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ
patthana17.24:4.1: abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… (saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā cha…pe… avigate cha.
